format:

```{=html}
<div class="site-wrap">
<header class="site-masthead">
  <span class="pill">Architecture 2.0</span>
  <span class="pill hot">Live search</span>
</header>

<section class="site-hero">
  <div class="hub-kicker">Paper search</div>
  <h1>arXiv search</h1>
  <p class="subtitle">Search arXiv preprints on AI-assisted computer architecture and chip design</p>
</section>

<p class="site-lede">
This page searches the titles and abstracts of arXiv preprints live from your
browser through the
<a href="https://openalex.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener">OpenAlex</a>
scholarly index; every result links to its paper page and PDF on arxiv.org.
Use it to scan recent work around Architecture 2.0 topics. Unlike the
<a href="/readings.html">curated reading list</a>, results here are not
reviewed or endorsed by the project. Combine a few plain keywords, or wrap
an exact phrase in quotes.
</p>

<nav class="site-actions" aria-label="Paper search actions">
  <a class="site-action secondary" href="/readings.html">Curated reading list</a>
  <a class="site-action secondary" href="/submit-resource.html">Submit a resource</a>
  <a class="site-action tertiary" id="arxiv-native-link" href="https://arxiv.org/search/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open this search on arXiv <span class="arr" aria-hidden="true">&nearr;</span></a>
</nav>

<form id="arxiv-form" class="arxiv-search" role="search" aria-label="Search arXiv preprints">
  <input id="arxiv-query" type="search" name="q" autocomplete="off"
         placeholder='e.g. LLM Verilog generation, "design space exploration"'
         aria-label="Search query for arXiv preprints">
  <button type="submit" class="site-action submit-button">Search <span class="arr" aria-hidden="true">&rarr;</span></button>
</form>

<div class="arxiv-search-controls">
  <label for="arxiv-sort">Sort by
    <select id="arxiv-sort">
      <option value="relevance" selected>Relevance</option>
      <option value="newest">Newest first</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label for="arxiv-since">Published
    <select id="arxiv-since">
      <option value="" selected>Any time</option>
      <option value="1">Past year</option>
      <option value="3">Past 3 years</option>
      <option value="5">Past 5 years</option>
    </select>
  </label>
</div>

<div class="arxiv-topics" role="group" aria-label="Suggested searches">
  <button type="button" data-query='"computer architecture" machine learning'>AI for computer architecture</button>
  <button type="button" data-query="LLM chip design">LLMs for chip design</button>
  <button type="button" data-query='"design space exploration" accelerator'>Design space exploration</button>
  <button type="button" data-query="machine learning electronic design automation">ML for EDA</button>
  <button type="button" data-query="LLM Verilog RTL generation">RTL generation</button>
  <button type="button" data-query="deep learning hardware accelerator">Hardware accelerators</button>
</div>

<p id="arxiv-status" class="arxiv-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>

<section id="arxiv-trend" class="arxiv-trend" hidden>
  <div class="arxiv-trend-head">
    <h2>Publication trend</h2>
    <div class="arxiv-trend-toggle" role="group" aria-label="Trend view">
      <button type="button" id="arxiv-trend-yearly" aria-pressed="true">Per year</button>
      <button type="button" id="arxiv-trend-cumulative" aria-pressed="false">Cumulative</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p id="arxiv-trend-caption" class="arxiv-trend-caption"></p>
  <svg id="arxiv-trend-svg" viewBox="0 0 720 210" role="img"
       aria-label="arXiv preprints per year matching the current query"></svg>
</section>
<div id="arxiv-trend-tip" class="arxiv-trend-tip" role="presentation" hidden></div>

<div id="arxiv-results" class="reading-listing arxiv-results"></div>

<div class="arxiv-more">
  <button type="button" id="arxiv-more-btn" class="site-action secondary submit-button" hidden>Load more results</button>
</div>

<p class="arxiv-note">
Results are arXiv preprints fetched live from the
<a href="https://docs.openalex.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener">OpenAlex API</a>
(data licensed CC0). Paper pages and PDFs open on
<a href="https://arxiv.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener">arxiv.org</a>.
</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var API = "https://api.openalex.org/works";
  var PAGE_SIZE = 12;
  var SELECT = "id,title,publication_date,authorships,abstract_inverted_index," +
    "primary_location,primary_topic";

  var form = document.getElementById("arxiv-form");
  var queryInput = document.getElementById("arxiv-query");
  var sortSelect = document.getElementById("arxiv-sort");
  var sinceSelect = document.getElementById("arxiv-since");
  var status = document.getElementById("arxiv-status");
  var results = document.getElementById("arxiv-results");
  var moreButton = document.getElementById("arxiv-more-btn");
  var nativeLink = document.getElementById("arxiv-native-link");

  var state = {
    query: "",
    page: 1,
    total: 0,
    shown: 0,
    controller: null
  };

  function setStatus(message, isError) {
    status.textContent = message;
    status.classList.toggle("error", Boolean(isError));
  }

  function cleanWhitespace(value) {
    return String(value || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  function truncate(value, limit) {
    if (value.length <= limit) {
      return value;
    }
    var cut = value.slice(0, limit);
    var lastSpace = cut.lastIndexOf(" ");
    return (lastSpace > limit * 0.6 ? cut.slice(0, lastSpace) : cut) + "…";
  }

  // OpenAlex stores abstracts as a word -> positions inverted index.
  function abstractText(inverted) {
    if (!inverted) {
      return "";
    }
    var words = [];
    Object.keys(inverted).forEach(function (word) {
      inverted[word].forEach(function (position) {
        words[position] = word;
      });
    });
    return cleanWhitespace(words.join(" "));
  }

  function workCard(work) {
    var location = work.primary_location || {};
    var landing = location.landing_page_url || work.id || "#";
    var pdfUrl = location.pdf_url || "";
    var title = cleanWhitespace(work.title) || "Untitled";
    var published = work.publication_date || "";
    var summary = truncate(abstractText(work.abstract_inverted_index), 340);
    var topic = work.primary_topic && work.primary_topic.display_name;

    var arxivId = "";
    var idMatch = String(landing).match(/arxiv\.org\/abs\/(.+)$/);
    if (idMatch) {
      arxivId = idMatch[1];
    }

    var authors = (work.authorships || []).map(function (authorship) {
      return authorship.author && authorship.author.display_name;
    }).filter(Boolean);
    var authorLine = authors.slice(0, 8).join(", ");
    if (authors.length > 8) {
      authorLine += ", et al.";
    }

    var card = document.createElement("article");
    card.className = "reading-card";
    var body = document.createElement("div");
    body.className = "reading-card-body";
    card.appendChild(body);

    var top = document.createElement("div");
    top.className = "tool-card-top";
    body.appendChild(top);

    var heading = document.createElement("div");
    top.appendChild(heading);

    var kind = document.createElement("p");
    kind.className = "reading-kind";
    kind.textContent = (arxivId ? "arXiv:" + arxivId : "arXiv") +
      (published ? " · " + published : "");
    heading.appendChild(kind);

    var titleNode = document.createElement("h3");
    titleNode.className = "listing-title";
    var titleLink = document.createElement("a");
    titleLink.href = landing;
    titleLink.target = "_blank";
    titleLink.rel = "noopener";
    titleLink.textContent = title;
    titleNode.appendChild(titleLink);
    heading.appendChild(titleNode);

    var arrow = document.createElement("a");
    arrow.className = "tool-card-arrow";
    arrow.href = landing;
    arrow.target = "_blank";
    arrow.rel = "noopener";
    arrow.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open " + title + " on arXiv");
    arrow.innerHTML = "&nearr;";
    top.appendChild(arrow);

    if (summary) {
      var description = document.createElement("p");
      description.className = "listing-description";
      description.textContent = summary;
      body.appendChild(description);
    }

    var meta = document.createElement("dl");
    meta.className = "tool-card-meta";
    if (authorLine) {
      var authorRow = document.createElement("div");
      var authorLabel = document.createElement("dt");
      authorLabel.textContent = "Authors";
      var authorValue = document.createElement("dd");
      authorValue.textContent = authorLine;
      authorRow.appendChild(authorLabel);
      authorRow.appendChild(authorValue);
      meta.appendChild(authorRow);
    }
    if (pdfUrl) {
      var pdfRow = document.createElement("div");
      var pdfLabel = document.createElement("dt");
      pdfLabel.textContent = "PDF";
      var pdfValue = document.createElement("dd");
      var pdfLink = document.createElement("a");
      pdfLink.href = pdfUrl;
      pdfLink.target = "_blank";
      pdfLink.rel = "noopener";
      pdfLink.textContent = "Download PDF";
      pdfValue.appendChild(pdfLink);
      pdfRow.appendChild(pdfLabel);
      pdfRow.appendChild(pdfValue);
      meta.appendChild(pdfRow);
    }
    if (meta.childNodes.length) {
      body.appendChild(meta);
    }

    if (topic) {
      var chips = document.createElement("div");
      chips.className = "listing-categories tool-card-categories";
      var chip = document.createElement("span");
      chip.className = "tool-card-category";
      chip.textContent = topic;
      chips.appendChild(chip);
      body.appendChild(chips);
    }

    return card;
  }

  function requestUrl() {
    // Matching titles and abstracts gives far more on-topic results than
    // OpenAlex's default full-text search. Commas would split the filter
    // list, so they are stripped from the query.
    var filters = [
      "title_and_abstract.search:" + state.query.replace(/,/g, " "),
      "indexed_in:arxiv"
    ];
    var years = Number(sinceSelect.value);
    if (years) {
      var cutoff = new Date();
      cutoff.setFullYear(cutoff.getFullYear() - years);
      filters.push("from_publication_date:" + cutoff.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    }
    var sort = sortSelect.value === "newest" ?
      "publication_date:desc" : "relevance_score:desc";
    return API +
      "?filter=" + encodeURIComponent(filters.join(",")) +
      "&sort=" + encodeURIComponent(sort) +
      "&page=" + state.page +
      "&per-page=" + PAGE_SIZE +
      "&select=" + encodeURIComponent(SELECT);
  }

  function fetchPage(append) {
    if (state.controller) {
      state.controller.abort();
    }
    state.controller = new AbortController();

    moreButton.hidden = true;
    setStatus(append ? "Loading more results…" : "Searching arXiv preprints…");
    if (!append) {
      results.textContent = "";
      state.shown = 0;
    }

    fetch(requestUrl(), { signal: state.controller.signal })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (response.status === 429) {
          throw new Error("rate-limited");
        }
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("the search API returned " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (data) {
        state.total = (data.meta && data.meta.count) || 0;
        (data.results || []).forEach(function (work) {
          results.appendChild(workCard(work));
          state.shown += 1;
        });

        if (!state.shown) {
          setStatus("No arXiv preprints match “" + state.query +
            "”. Try fewer or broader terms.");
          return;
        }

        setStatus("Showing " + state.shown + " of " +
          state.total.toLocaleString() + " arXiv preprints for “" +
          state.query + "”.");
        moreButton.hidden = state.shown >= state.total;
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        if (error.name === "AbortError") {
          return;
        }
        if (error.message === "rate-limited") {
          setStatus("The search API is rate-limited right now. " +
            "Wait a minute and try again.", true);
        } else {
          setStatus("Search failed (" + error.message +
            "). Check your connection and try again.", true);
        }
        moreButton.hidden = state.shown === 0;
      });
  }

  var trendSection = document.getElementById("arxiv-trend");
  var trendSvg = document.getElementById("arxiv-trend-svg");
  var trendCaption = document.getElementById("arxiv-trend-caption");
  var trendTip = document.getElementById("arxiv-trend-tip");
  var trendYearlyBtn = document.getElementById("arxiv-trend-yearly");
  var trendCumulativeBtn = document.getElementById("arxiv-trend-cumulative");
  var trend = { years: [], counts: [], mode: "yearly", controller: null };
  var THIS_YEAR = new Date().getFullYear();

  function svgNode(name, attrs) {
    var el = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.keys(attrs).forEach(function (key) {
      el.setAttribute(key, attrs[key]);
    });
    return el;
  }

  function niceCeil(value) {
    var pow = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(value || 1)));
    var steps = [1, 2, 5, 10];
    for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i += 1) {
      if (steps[i] * pow >= value) {
        return steps[i] * pow;
      }
    }
    return 10 * pow;
  }

  function tickLabel(value) {
    return value % 1 ? value.toFixed(1) : String(value);
  }

  function renderTrend() {
    var W = 720, H = 210;
    var M = { top: 14, right: 48, bottom: 26, left: 42 };
    var years = trend.years;
    var counts = trend.counts;
    var cumulativeCounts = [];
    var running = 0;
    counts.forEach(function (count) {
      running += count;
      cumulativeCounts.push(running);
    });
    var data = trend.mode === "cumulative" ? cumulativeCounts : counts;
    var max = niceCeil(Math.max.apply(null, data));
    var xPos = function (i) {
      return M.left + (W - M.left - M.right) *
        (years.length === 1 ? 0.5 : i / (years.length - 1));
    };
    var yPos = function (v) {
      return H - M.bottom - (H - M.top - M.bottom) * (v / max);
    };

    while (trendSvg.firstChild) {
      trendSvg.removeChild(trendSvg.firstChild);
    }

    [max, max / 2].forEach(function (tick) {
      trendSvg.appendChild(svgNode("line", {
        x1: M.left, x2: W - M.right, y1: yPos(tick), y2: yPos(tick),
        stroke: "var(--arch2-line)", "stroke-width": 1
      }));
      var label = svgNode("text", {
        x: M.left - 7, y: yPos(tick) + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end",
        fill: "var(--arch2-muted)", "font-size": 11,
        style: "font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums"
      });
      label.textContent = tickLabel(tick);
      trendSvg.appendChild(label);
    });
    trendSvg.appendChild(svgNode("line", {
      x1: M.left, x2: W - M.right, y1: yPos(0), y2: yPos(0),
      stroke: "var(--arch2-line-strong)", "stroke-width": 1
    }));
    var tickYears = years.length > 2 ?
      [years[0], years[Math.floor((years.length - 1) / 2)], years[years.length - 1]] :
      years;
    tickYears.forEach(function (year) {
      var label = svgNode("text", {
        x: xPos(years.indexOf(year)), y: H - 8, "text-anchor": "middle",
        fill: "var(--arch2-muted)", "font-size": 11,
        style: "font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums"
      });
      label.textContent = year;
      trendSvg.appendChild(label);
    });

    var points = data.map(function (value, i) {
      return [xPos(i), yPos(value)];
    });
    var toPath = function (list) {
      return list.map(function (point, i) {
        return (i ? "L" : "M") + point[0].toFixed(1) + " " + point[1].toFixed(1);
      }).join(" ");
    };
    trendSvg.appendChild(svgNode("path", {
      d: toPath(points) +
        " L" + points[points.length - 1][0].toFixed(1) + " " + yPos(0).toFixed(1) +
        " L" + points[0][0].toFixed(1) + " " + yPos(0).toFixed(1) + " Z",
      fill: "var(--arch2-blue-deep)", "fill-opacity": 0.09
    }));
    if (points.length > 1) {
      trendSvg.appendChild(svgNode("path", {
        d: toPath(points.slice(0, points.length - 1)),
        fill: "none", stroke: "var(--arch2-blue-deep)", "stroke-width": 2,
        "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round"
      }));
      // The last segment covers the in-progress year, so it is dashed.
      trendSvg.appendChild(svgNode("path", {
        d: toPath(points.slice(points.length - 2)),
        fill: "none", stroke: "var(--arch2-blue-deep)", "stroke-width": 2,
        "stroke-dasharray": "4 4", "stroke-linecap": "round"
      }));
    }
    var endPoint = points[points.length - 1];
    trendSvg.appendChild(svgNode("circle", {
      cx: endPoint[0], cy: endPoint[1], r: 4,
      fill: "var(--arch2-panel)", stroke: "var(--arch2-blue-deep)",
      "stroke-width": 2
    }));
    var endLabel = svgNode("text", {
      x: endPoint[0] + 9, y: endPoint[1] + 4, fill: "var(--arch2-ink)",
      "font-size": 12, "font-weight": 700,
      style: "font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums"
    });
    endLabel.textContent = data[data.length - 1].toLocaleString();
    trendSvg.appendChild(endLabel);

    var crosshair = svgNode("line", {
      x1: 0, x2: 0, y1: M.top, y2: H - M.bottom,
      stroke: "var(--arch2-line-strong)", "stroke-width": 1,
      visibility: "hidden"
    });
    var hoverDot = svgNode("circle", {
      cx: 0, cy: 0, r: 4, fill: "var(--arch2-blue-deep)",
      stroke: "var(--arch2-panel)", "stroke-width": 2, visibility: "hidden"
    });
    trendSvg.appendChild(crosshair);
    trendSvg.appendChild(hoverDot);

    var hitArea = svgNode("rect", {
      x: M.left, y: M.top, width: W - M.left - M.right,
      height: H - M.top - M.bottom, fill: "transparent"
    });
    trendSvg.appendChild(hitArea);
    hitArea.addEventListener("mousemove", function (event) {
      var box = trendSvg.getBoundingClientRect();
      var mx = (event.clientX - box.left) * (W / box.width);
      var i = Math.max(0, Math.min(years.length - 1, Math.round(
        (mx - M.left) / (W - M.left - M.right) * (years.length - 1))));
      crosshair.setAttribute("x1", points[i][0]);
      crosshair.setAttribute("x2", points[i][0]);
      crosshair.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
      hoverDot.setAttribute("cx", points[i][0]);
      hoverDot.setAttribute("cy", points[i][1]);
      hoverDot.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
      trendTip.textContent = years[i] +
        (years[i] === THIS_YEAR ? " (year-to-date)" : "") +
        " · " + counts[i].toLocaleString() + " new · " +
        cumulativeCounts[i].toLocaleString() + " total";
      trendTip.hidden = false;
      trendTip.style.left =
        Math.min(event.clientX + 14, window.innerWidth - 230) + "px";
      trendTip.style.top = (event.clientY + 14) + "px";
    });
    hitArea.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {
      crosshair.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
      hoverDot.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
      trendTip.hidden = true;
    });

    var total = counts.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
    trendCaption.textContent = total.toLocaleString() +
      " arXiv preprints since " + years[0] + " match “" + state.query +
      "”. " + THIS_YEAR + " is year-to-date.";
  }

  function fetchTrend(query) {
    if (trend.controller) {
      trend.controller.abort();
    }
    trend.controller = new AbortController();
    var filters = "title_and_abstract.search:" + query.replace(/,/g, " ") +
      ",indexed_in:arxiv";
    var url = API + "?filter=" + encodeURIComponent(filters) +
      "&group_by=publication_year&per-page=200";
    fetch(url, { signal: trend.controller.signal })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("trend request returned " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (data) {
        var byYear = {};
        (data.group_by || []).forEach(function (group) {
          var year = parseInt(group.key, 10);
          if (year >= 1991 && year <= THIS_YEAR) {
            byYear[year] = group.count;
          }
        });
        var seen = Object.keys(byYear).map(Number);
        if (!seen.length) {
          trendSection.hidden = true;
          return;
        }
        var first = Math.min.apply(null, seen);
        first = Math.max(first, THIS_YEAR - 30);
        first = Math.min(first, THIS_YEAR - 5);
        trend.years = [];
        trend.counts = [];
        for (var year = first; year <= THIS_YEAR; year += 1) {
          trend.years.push(year);
          trend.counts.push(byYear[year] || 0);
        }
        trendSection.hidden = false;
        renderTrend();
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        if (error.name !== "AbortError") {
          trendSection.hidden = true;
        }
      });
  }

  function setTrendMode(next) {
    trend.mode = next;
    trendYearlyBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(next === "yearly"));
    trendCumulativeBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(next === "cumulative"));
    if (trend.years.length) {
      renderTrend();
    }
  }
  trendYearlyBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    setTrendMode("yearly");
  });
  trendCumulativeBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    setTrendMode("cumulative");
  });

  function runSearch(raw, updateUrl) {
    var query = cleanWhitespace(raw);
    if (!query) {
      setStatus("Enter a few search terms first.");
      return;
    }
    state.query = query;
    state.page = 1;
    nativeLink.href = "https://arxiv.org/search/?searchtype=all&query=" +
      encodeURIComponent(query);
    if (updateUrl !== false) {
      var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      params.set("q", query);
      window.history.replaceState(null, "", "?" + params.toString());
    }
    fetchPage(false);
    fetchTrend(query);
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    runSearch(queryInput.value);
  });

  moreButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
    state.page += 1;
    fetchPage(true);
  });

  sortSelect.addEventListener("change", function () {
    if (state.query) {
      state.page = 1;
      fetchPage(false);
    }
  });

  sinceSelect.addEventListener("change", function () {
    if (state.query) {
      state.page = 1;
      fetchPage(false);
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll(".arxiv-topics button").forEach(function (button) {
    button.addEventListener("click", function () {
      queryInput.value = button.getAttribute("data-query") || "";
      runSearch(queryInput.value);
    });
  });

  var fromUrl = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("q");
  var initial = fromUrl || '"computer architecture" machine learning';
  queryInput.value = initial;
  runSearch(initial, Boolean(fromUrl));
})();
</script>
```
